method: public Bybit REST, closed bars only. z / sigma from research.frame.enrich_bars (EWMA 0.94) + add_robust_vol; v0 cells from research.regimes.label; shock state = strategies.shock.ShockRegime on ~2,500 1h bars; flush and H-RB2 state = the post_cascade_study frozen design (r48 < 1y p5, OI <= -5% vs 72h max, R9, 42-bar decluster, 1.5 sigma arm, first 4h close back below EMA20) on ~3,000 4h bars + Bybit 4h OI. Scratch scripts (not in repo): alpha_scan.py, rescan_1h.py. Liquidations from the lake (Lake.read_asof). DVOL from Deribit public API.
